Geographies Served Programs Yuva Udyami District Tumkur Bangalore State Karnataka District Tumkur Bangalore States Karnataka Yuva Udyami is an initiative focused on cultivating self-employment and entrepreneurship among youth residing in peri-urban and rural areas. Our model is designed to empower young individuals, fostering an ecosystem conducive to the growth of micro-enterprises, thereby bolstering employment opportunities in India. Through our entrepreneurship development program, we aim to assist aspiring entrepreneurs in establishing their own ventures by providing access to capital, ongoing post-investment support, and mentorship from seasoned experts and thereby, we strive to empower young individuals, enabling them to become self-sufficient and fostering positive impacts not only in their own lives but also within the broader community. Sushikshana District Chamrajnagar Chitradurga Tumkur Belgaum Osmanabad Kolhapur Erode Salem Ramanathapuram Buldhana Tirupattur State Karnataka Tamil Nadu Maharashtra District Chamrajnagar Chitradurga Tumkur Belgaum Osmanabad Kolhapur Erode Salem Ramanathapuram Buldhana Tirupattur States Karnataka Tamil Nadu Maharashtra Sushikshana is a comprehensive life skills education program designed for high school students across government, and aided schools to empower children to become lifelong learners, make informed decisions, and realize their potential to lead healthy and productive lives. 3 Zero Club District Tumkur Belgaum Mandya State Karnataka District Tumkur Belgaum Mandya States Karnataka The 3Zero Club is an initiative towards achieving the Nobel Peace Laureate Professor Muhammad Yunus’s vision of creating a world of three zeros — zero net carbon emission, zero wealth concentration for ending poverty, and zero unemployment by unleashing entrepreneurship in all. The mission of the 3 Zero Club is to inspire and enable the youth to ideate, create and lead with the entrepreneurial spirit to solve the most pressing social and environmental issues of our time.
